summary: Israel struck the Nasser Hospital complex in Khan Younis, killing six and targeting a senior Hamas commander, the third brigade commander eliminated. Iran experienced a missile launch from Khuzestan and an explosion in Hormozgan, while its air defenses activated in multiple provinces. Lebanon recorded 111 alerts with 38 drone sightings and 30 artillery strikes, indicating sustained cross-border hostilities.

sections.executive_summary: Israel struck the Nasser Hospital complex in Khan Younis, killing six and targeting a senior Hamas commander, the third brigade commander eliminated. Iran experienced a missile launch from Khuzestan and an explosion in Hormozgan, while its air defenses activated in multiple provinces. Lebanon recorded 111 alerts with 38 drone sightings and 30 artillery strikes, indicating sustained cross-border hostilities.

points: A missile was launched from Sarbandar in Khuzestan Province at 1844Z, as reported by the FromIran monitoring channel with a 120-second delay, indicating ongoing Iranian missile activity. (Source: @shin_persian/12291)

An explosion occurred near Sarkhur Tahruyi in Sirik, Hormozgan Province, documented by the same monitoring channel with delayed posting, suggesting a possible strike or accident in southern Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/12293)

An unmanned aerial vehicle launch from Omidiyeh was accompanied by heavy anti-aircraft activity in Khuzestan Province, signaling heightened air defense readiness in the region. (Source: @shin_persian/12296)
Anti-aircraft activity was recorded in Izeh, Khuzestan Province at 1910Z, further indicating persistent defensive operations across the province. (Source: @shin_persian/12295)
Israeli media reported an attack in the southern Iranian city of Sirik near the Gulf of Oman coast, though details remain unconfirmed by official sources. (Source: @yediotnews25/137767)

The IDF weapons return campaign has collected over 300,000 pieces of military equipment, including 210 firearms, 3,800 grenades and mortars, 8,700 uniforms, and 1,600 combat equipment items, prompting a two-day extension. (Source: @manniefabian/59510)

Prime Minister Netanyahu and military secretary Maj. Gen. Guy Markizeno provided a security and diplomatic briefing to Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot at the Prime Minister's Office. (Source: @manniefabian/59508)
The Israeli military targeted the Khan Yunis brigade commander in Hamas, marking the third such commander killed since the war began. (Source: @amitsegal/67152)
Red Alert sirens activated in the Gaza Envelope community of Nachal Oz with a 15-second warning time, indicating an incoming projectile threat from Gaza. (Source: @tzevaadom_en/68583)
Defense Minister Israel Katz held a security assessment today, though details were not disclosed in the truncated message. (Source: @manniefabian/59512)

An Israeli strike on the Nasser Hospital complex in Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip, targeted a senior Hamas commander and other members, killing six people and wounding others. (Source: @manniefabian/59506)
The strike specifically aimed at the Khan Yunis brigade commander, the third Hamas brigade commander eliminated since the start of the war. (Source: @amitsegal/67152)
A Red Alert warning was issued for Nachal Oz in the Gaza Envelope with only 15 seconds to shelter, signaling continued rocket threat from Gaza. (Source: @tzevaadom_en/68583)
No additional ground operations or casualty figures for the West Bank were reported in the current messages.

Daily monitoring recorded 111 alerts across Lebanon, including 38 drone sightings, with the most monitored villages being Meifdon (6), Jmeijmeh (3), Safad al-Battikh (3), Shqra (3), and Nabatieh al-Fawqa (2). (Source: @redlinkleb/52939)
The most active districts were Nabatieh (44 alerts), Bint Jbeil (32), and Marjayoun (23), indicating concentrated activity in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/52939)
Seven airstrikes were reported: Hadatha (2), Ali al-Taher (1), Wadi al-Salouqi (1), Al-Mansouri (1), Hula (1), and Al-Qantara (1). (Source: @redlinkleb/52939)

Thirty artillery shelling incidents were recorded across multiple locations including Wadi Zibqin (4), Al-Mansouri (3), Wadi al-Salouqi (3), Meifdon (3), Kfar Tibnit (2), and others. (Source: @redlinkleb/52939)
Additional artillery shelling was reported in Wadi al-Salouqi and fire sweeping operations in Zoutr al-Sharqiya. (Source: @redlinkleb/52941, @redlinkleb/52946)

Iraqi Prime Minister Al-Zaidi ordered an investigation into fuel siphoning in Jurf al-Sakhar, a closed-off area south of Baghdad known as a stronghold for IRGC-backed Kataib Hezbollah. (Source: @shin_persian/12306)
